versions.content: The job of the function NvM_WriteBlock shall assume a re ferenced permanent RAM block or the RAM mirror in the NvM module in case of explicit synchronization to be valid when the request is passed to the NvM module. If the permanent RAM block is still in an invalid state, the function NvM_WriteBlock shall valida te it automatically before copying the RAM block contents to NV memory or after calling explicit synchronization callback (NvM_WriteRamBlockToNvm).

The job of the function NvM_WriteBlock shall assume a re ferenced permanent RAM block or the RAM mirror in the NvM module in case of explicit synchronization to be valid when the request is passed to the NvM module. If the permanent RAM block is still in an invalid state, the function NvM_WriteBlock shall valida te it automatically before copying the RAM block contents to NV memory or after calling explicit synchronization callback (NvM_WriteRamBlockToNvm).
If the block is successfully enqueued and if the RAM block state is VALID/UNCHANGED or INVALID/UNCHANGED, the function NvM_WriteBlock shall set the RAM block state to VALID/CHANGED.
If the block is successfully enqueued and if the RAM block state is VALID/UNCHANGED or INVALID/UNCHANGED, the function NvM_WriteBlock shall set the RAM block state to VALID/CHANGED.
